name: reviewstore-writers
expectation: ReviewStore is written only by the Service(s) the compiled model declares as its writers (today AssignmentService, of its owning context PeerReview).

boundary.statement: Every write to the tables of ReviewStore made by the runtime code of the deployable (src/**), through any channel: literal SQL, SQL handed to the database as a variable, and file- or handle-level mechanisms that can change the database file.
includes: src/** (the QuorumServer deployable and its operator CLI src/ops.ts)

excludes.why: not part of the deployable; they never run in production

excludes.what: schema DDL (CREATE TABLE / INDEX / TRIGGER) in src/platform/schema.ts
excludes.why: defines the store; it writes no rows. Any INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE inside a migration is NOT excluded: it is scanned like any other literal
replaces the entire database file with a verified backup — every store at once, by the Operator actor; it is not a context writing a store
deletes the whole database file before re-seeding a demo; never runs when NODE_ENV=production. The seed's rows are written through the context services, whose SQL is scanned

excludes.what: writes to files that are not the database: the server pid file, the token secret, the outbound mail log
excludes.why: each targets its own file (pidFileFor(dbFile), <data>/token-secret, <data>/mail.jsonl), never the database

scope.discovery: Lex every module under src/; every INSERT / REPLACE / UPDATE … SET / DELETE FROM in a string or template literal is a write site; its table is resolved to a store through continuum/evidence.json (each Resource's schema.ts citation range holds the tables created in it); a site is in scope when its table belongs to ReviewStore. Every non-literal SQL argument and every file/handle mechanism must be resolved or excluded above, else the scope is incomplete.

assumptions.statement: A table belongs to the store whose evidence.json citation range in src/platform/schema.ts contains its CREATE TABLE. The model declares no bindings, so this mapping is evidence, not a model claim; a rev_* table no range covers is reported unresolved.

A write site's writer is the one Service continuum/evidence.json cites for its module (directly or through an element nested in it). A module cited for no Service, or for several, has no attributable writer and its sites are unresolved.
The database is reached only through better-sqlite3 handles; .prepare is always SQL, and .exec is SQL only on a receiver named db/#db. SQL keywords are matched case-insensitively.

The judgment is about the code at the commit, statically; a write that only exists at runtime through a channel the scanner does not recognise would not be seen. The scanner reports the channels it found and could not follow as unresolved.

checks.statement: the set of ReviewStore write sites is complete: at least one discovered, no channel unresolved
the site's module realises a Service the compiled model declares as a writer of ReviewStore

challenges.statement: Adjudication writes a ReviewStore table directly (029 controlled mismatch M1, reused)

violations.statement: a service the model does not declare as a ReviewStore writer writes one of its tables
